telefono.title: On your phone
telefono.keys: phone mobile iphone android safari keyboard writing preview go to pages scenes characters text size side menu scrolling send file smarttab find replace
q: how do I write on my phone
how do I jump to a page
how do I close the phone menu
how do I make the phone text bigger
telefono.short: On your phone, writing fills the screen. The top bar shows pages and words. The side menu holds commands and settings.
body: On your phone, text wraps to fit the screen, without page dividers. Fountain types and bold, italic and underline stay visible. Formatting symbols stay hidden. When you scroll to reread, the view stays where you leave it. It returns to the caret when you start typing or editing again.

The top bar shows the menu, file name, caret page, total pages and document word count. You also have Go to, Undo, Redo and Preview. A shared document has a dot beside the name, with the same green, yellow and red states as on the computer. Tap it to open Sharing.

While you type, **SmartTab**, with the ⇥ symbol, sits right under the top bar. Tap to change type, or press and hold to choose from the list. At the end of a character cue, **( )** adds a parenthetical. Next are B, I, U and Aa for bold, italic, underline and uppercase/lowercase, then a comment button and the magnifying glass for find and replace. Scene and character suggestions replace the buttons after SmartTab while you can choose one. Tap a suggestion to accept it. The strip disappears when you close the keyboard.

Tap **☰**: the menu slides in **from the left**. It has Dark theme, Scene numbers and Revision highlights switches that show their actual state, followed by Text size and Lingua / Language. Below are New document, Open another document, Title page, Find and replace, Comments, Sharing, and Help and manual. Tap outside the panel or **swipe left** to close it. Text size, from 14 to 26 px, is remembered on this device and does not change the PDF.

**Go to** lists Scenes, Pages and Characters. Type `page 12A`, `scene 7` or a word, then press Enter. Start, Last edit and End take you to useful places in the document. Page labels still match the printed pages, even though the writing view has no dividers.

**Preview** shows the actual printed pages and does not let you edit text. Scroll between pages and pinch with two fingers to zoom. The magnifying glass searches without replacing. **Go to** lists pages and offers Start and End. The X, “Close preview”, returns to writing. The standard share icon, an arrow leaving a box, opens Export PDF (print or save) and Send file. Sending prepares a Fountain copy with the document information. It uses your device’s share sheet, or downloads the copy if sharing is unavailable.

**Title page** opens a full-screen form with title, credit, author, draft, date and contact fields. Save to apply the fields and return to the document. Writing, autosave, comments and sharing use the same commands as on the computer.

**Export PDF** lets you include the title page and choose all pages or a range, using the actual labels, such as 12A. If there are revisions, you can choose marked pages only. These options also work on the computer and with [[Mod+P]]. Tablets keep the computer’s page view.

segnala.title: Reporting a problem or suggestion
segnala.keys: report bug error problem suggestion idea question contact help support email feedback developer
q: how do I report a bug
I found an error
I want to suggest a feature
how do I contact support
how do I contact the developer
segnala.short: Help → Contact the developer…: describe what happened. Your email is optional; include it only if you want a reply. Every report is read and considered.
body: **Help → Contact the developer…** opens a short form. Choose whether you are reporting a problem, making a suggestion, or asking a question. Describe what happened, what you expected, and, if possible, the steps to reproduce it.
- Your **email is optional**. Include it only if you want to be contacted for more details or a reply.
- If you choose, the report includes **technical details** (version, browser, and system). Your document text is never sent.
- If you are offline, the report is saved and sent automatically when possible.
Reports go to the salvatorefrisina.com server and are not shared with anyone else.

scorciatoie.title: Keyboard shortcuts
scorciatoie.keys: shortcuts keyboard keys commands hotkeys list
q: what keyboard shortcuts are available
keyboard shortcuts
list of commands
scorciatoie.short: The main shortcuts: [[Mod+S]] to Save, [[Mod+Z]] to Undo, [[Mod+F]] to Find, [[Mod+B]]/[[Mod+I]]/[[Mod+U]] for emphasis, [[Tab]] to change text type, and [[Mod+P]] for PDF. This help topic has the full list.
body: ## File
- [[Mod+O]] Open · [[Mod+S]] Save · [[Mod+Shift+S]] Save As · [[Alt+Shift+W]] Close project · [[Mod+P]] Export PDF
## Writing
- [[Tab]] / [[Shift+Tab]] change text type · [[Enter]] new paragraph · [[Shift+Enter]] line break within the same paragraph · [[Mod+Enter]] new page
- [[Mod+Z]] Undo · [[Mod+Shift+Z]] Redo
- [[Mod+B]] bold · [[Mod+I]] italic · [[Mod+U]] underline · [[Mod+Shift+K]] uppercase/lowercase
- [[Mod+F]] Find · [[Mod+Alt+F]] Find and replace
## Format
- [[Alt+Shift+L]] align left · [[Alt+Shift+E]] center · [[Alt+Shift+J]] justify · [[Alt+Shift+I]] indent
## Revisions
- [[Alt+Shift+R]] track revisions · [[Alt+Shift+V]] show highlights · [[Alt+Shift+H]] highlighter · [[Alt+Shift+G]] eraser · [[Alt+Shift+A]] actor copies
## Comments and view
- [[Mod+Alt+M]] add comment · [[Alt+Shift+C]] comments · [[Alt+Shift+N]] scene numbers · [[Alt+Shift+D]] dark theme
## Help
- [[F1]] Ask ScripToti

p-personaggio.title: The character name is not recognized
p-personaggio.keys: character name not recognized stays left not centered uppercase cue action
q: the character name stays on the left
it does not recognize my character
I type a name but it does not become a character cue
p-personaggio.short: The name must be in UPPERCASE (at least two letters), followed by dialogue on a new line. If it still does not work, press [[Tab]] until you reach “Character” or put “@” before the name.
body: - Write the name **entirely in uppercase**, with at least two letters, and press [[Enter]]. The next line is for dialogue.
- The name must be on a line **by itself**, preceded by a blank line.
- For names with numbers, special characters, or lowercase letters, press [[Tab]] until you reach “Character,” or put `@` in front (`@Dr. House`).
See also “Character cues and dialogue.”

p-dialogo.title: I cannot leave dialogue
p-dialogo.keys: leave exit dialogue stuck action after dialogue enter shift line break second line
q: I cannot leave dialogue
how do I exit dialogue
end a speech
how do I return to action after dialogue
how do I add a line break within dialogue
p-dialogo.short: Press [[Enter]] to end the speech and switch to Action. To add a line break within the same speech, use [[Shift+Enter]].
body: At the end of a speech, press [[Enter]] to end the dialogue and move the cursor to **Action**. For a second line within the same speech, press [[Shift+Enter]]. You can also press [[Tab]] until you reach “Action.”

p-slugline.title: The scene heading is not recognized
p-slugline.keys: slugline scene heading not recognized not uppercase int not working interior
q: I type INT. but it does not recognize the slugline
the scene heading stays lowercase
INTERIOR does not work
p-slugline.short: Start with “INT.” or “EXT.” (lowercase “int.” works too). Put the heading on its own line, preceded by a blank line. ScripToti also recognizes the Italian “EST.” prefix. Writing “INTERIOR” in full is not recognized; Syntax check can fix it.
body: - Start the line with `INT.`, the Italian `EST.`, `EXT.`, the Italian `INT./EST.`, or `I/E`. Lowercase works too: ScripToti makes it uppercase automatically.
- Put it on its own line, with a blank line before it.
- The full words “INTERIOR” and “EXTERIOR” are not recognized. Use abbreviations, or put a period in front (`.INTERIOR HOUSE`).
- You can always force it by pressing [[Tab]] until you reach “Scene heading.”

p-transizione.title: The transition is not aligned right
p-transizione.keys: transition not right aligned cut dissolve stays left becomes character cue
q: my dissolve is not aligned right
CUT TO stays on the left
my transition becomes a character cue
p-transizione.short: Write the transition on its own line and press Enter. ScripToti recognizes it, even in lowercase, and aligns it right. For a transition it does not recognize, put “>” in front: “> FADE TO WHITE:”.
body: Common transitions (CUT TO:, FADE OUT., the Italian forms DISSOLVENZA A: and STACCO SU:, and the others listed under **Transitions**) are recognized when you press [[Enter]] at the end of the line, even if you typed them in lowercase. For a line that was already there, move to the end and press [[Enter]], or use Syntax check. For a different transition, put `>` in front: `> FADE TO WHITE:`.
Without a blank line after the transition, it is mistaken for a character cue. Syntax check can fix both cases.

p-esclamativo.title: A symbol (! @ > .) is visible in the text
p-esclamativo.keys: visible exclamation mark symbol at sign marker showing in text
q: the exclamation mark is visible
I see an at sign before the name
there is a strange symbol in my text
p-esclamativo.short: Fountain symbols are hidden only at the start of a line. If you can see them, they are inside the text or combined, such as “@!”. Delete them and use [[Tab]] to change the type.
body: `!`, `@`, `.`, `>`, and `~` are hidden only as the **first character** of a line. If you see one, it is probably inside the text or next to another marker. Delete it and use [[Tab]] to choose the type.
Typing `!` at the start of a forced character cue or scene heading changes it to Action without leaving visible symbols.

p-pagine.title: Blank pages or “1b” pages that will not go away
p-pagine.keys: blank page empty pages last page will not disappear 1b 1c added pages a-pages revision locked pages
q: I have a blank page
the last blank page will not go away
why are there pages numbered 1b
p-pagine.short: Blank lines create blank pages: delete them with [[Backspace]]. Pages 1b, 1c… are added pages from locked production numbering. If you do not need them, choose Revisions → Close revisions and unlock numbering.
body: - A blank page contains blank lines. Move the cursor there and delete them with [[Backspace]] or [[Canc]]. The page disappears automatically.

- With **pages and scene numbers locked** (Revisions), original pages stay even when empty, so numbering does not change. Extra text goes onto pages 1b, 1c… If you are not preparing a production revision, choose Revisions → Close revisions and unlock numbering.

p-salvataggio.title: Saving asks for permission or fails
p-salvataggio.keys: save failed permission authorize press save reconnect file unsaved retry saving error
q: press Save to grant access
my file will not save
the file needs reconnecting
retry saving
p-salvataggio.short: Allow your browser to change the file when it asks. Choose “Allow on every visit” if available. The file reconnects automatically when you reopen the app. If permission is needed, the browser asks when you first type or click. Meanwhile, your text is kept in browser recovery.
body: For safety, your browser asks for permission to change a file. If you choose **Allow on every visit** in Chrome's prompt, files reconnect automatically when you reopen ScripToti, without further prompts.

If permission has expired, the browser asks when you first type or click in the document. Choose **Allow**. You can also click **Save** ([[Mod+S]]) when the top-right status says “press Save to grant access” or “needs reconnecting.”
Your text is not lost: it is kept in browser recovery while you wait (File → Recovery…).

p-condivisione.title: Sharing will not connect
p-condivisione.keys: sharing not working connecting red offline changes not arriving
q: sharing is not working
I cannot see the other person's changes
it stays on connecting
p-condivisione.short: Check the status light. If it is red, check your connection or VPN. You need internet for the first connection; changes arrive in about a second. If it says “no longer available,” the sharing session has been deleted.
body: - **Red, offline**: there is no connection. Changes will be sent automatically.
- **“the site is blocking this network (VPN?)”**: turn off the VPN or exclude the site from it.
- **“connecting…”** for a long time: the first time you open a shared document on a computer, you need internet.
- **“Sharing no longer available”**: the document is no longer shared on the server. Your file remains an ordinary copy.

dettatura.title: Dictation
dettatura.short: Tap the microphone (on a phone the round button at the bottom, on a computer the one in the toolbar) and speak: the text goes in where the cursor is. You can also say commands such as “new line”, “character Marta”, “new scene interior kitchen night”.
body: Tap the **microphone**: on a phone the round button at the bottom right, on a computer the one next to Share in the toolbar. Speak normally: the text appears in grey while you talk and goes into the document at the cursor as soon as you pause. On a phone the keyboard stays closed, so you can see the text.

The language is the one set in **Spellcheck** (Italian or English). Recognition is the browser’s: Apple on iPhone and Safari, Google in Chrome. It needs an internet connection and permission to use the microphone; Firefox has no dictation.
## Commands
- “**new line**”: a new paragraph.
- “**new scene** interior kitchen night”: becomes `INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT`. “Exterior” (EXT.) and times of day work too: day, night, morning, evening, dawn…
- “**character** Marta”: the name becomes a character cue and what you say next is the line. If recognition mangles the name, ScripToti uses the matching character of the document.
- “**parenthetical** quietly”: a parenthetical in the speech. It ends at the first pause, or when you say “close parenthesis”.
- “**cut to**”, “dissolve to”, “fade out”: a transition.
- “**undo**” said on its own: takes back the last step. “**stop dictation**”: stops listening.
In Italian: «a capo», «nuova scena interno cucina notte», «personaggio Marta», «parentesi», «stacco», «annulla», «stop dettatura».

The panel has **Type ⇥** (like Tab), **New paragraph**, **Backspace**, **Delete** (forward) and **Undo**. Hold Backspace or Delete to keep deleting: on your phone the keyboard stays closed. **Keyboard** stops dictation and opens the keyboard; **Done** closes the panel. The final phrase can still arrive before the microphone stops. Switching documents closes dictation and discards late phrases.

rinomina-file.title: Renaming a file
rinomina-file.keys: rename file name change filename script title top bar
q: how do I change the file name
rename my script
how do I rename a file
rinomina-file.short: Click the file name at the top center, enter a new name, and press Enter (Esc cancels). You can also use File → Rename….
body: As in Google Docs, click the **file name at the top center**, enter a new name, and press **Enter**. **Esc** leaves the name unchanged. You can also use **File → Rename…**.
If your browser can rename the file on your device and check its folder, the name changes there too. The document keeps saving to the same file. Allow the browser to edit the file if it asks.

ScripToti checks that the new name is available in the folder, including files you have never opened here. If a file or folder already uses that name, or the destination cannot be checked, it refuses to rename. Use **File → Save As…** to choose a destination with your browser.
